ValidationRule.description: This rule triggers when case request type is order and status is closed and order Ids is left blank .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" ,ISPICKVAL( IME_SC_Request_Type__c , "Order") , ISPICKVAL (Status , "Closed") , ISBLANK( IME_SC_Order_Id__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter value for Order Ids field.
